sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Beyond the Red Meat is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Right, we'll put you to work then, since you're just hanging around here doing nothing. We've got this lad in our crew who's an absolute wizard with a spoon, his cooking is bloody incredible! I want to get him a little gift, show him some appreciation for looking after the lads. There's a fancy restaurant on Klimov Street downtown, supposedly the best chefs around and all that. Head over there, have a look around, see what you can find. Maybe you'll come across some secret recipe or something."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain information on culinary secrets at the Beluga restaurant on Streets of Tarkov
- Hand over the found data

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Skier Rep +0.25
- 1,000 Euros
  - 1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
"A journal, huh? That's fine, I guess."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Chef's diary | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
| Beluga restaurant director key | 1 | Required* | N/A | Unlocks the director’s office in the Beluga restaurant. |
- Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest.

In this quest you have to find the Chef's diary in the Beluga restaurant on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: On the second floor, on the shelf within the oval bar tucked between towels.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: On the third floor, on the shelf under the bar.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: On the third floor in the kitchen, placed within a cabinet near the four sinks.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: On the third floor inside the restaurant director's room, on the illuminated shelf.
